Virat Kohli on the verge of breaking Sachin Tendulkar's big record
articles.description: Virat Kohli is approaching a significant milestone ahead of the first ODI against New Zealand. He currently ranks as the third-highest run-scorer for India in ODIs played in New Zealand. Kohli needs 139 more runs to break Sachin Tendulkar's record of 652 runs in this category. The Indian team will feature a solid top order of right-handed batsmen for the series.

articles.title: California judge orders one former partner to pay the other $66,192 in legal fees after house dispute
articles.description: Matthew Shroder and Mackenzie Fotsch are currently embroiled in legal disputes regarding a jointly owned property in Sausalito. After achieving a partial victory in a motion to strike, Shroder sought $90,010 in attorney fees and the court awarded him $66,192.50. This amount includes $40,887.50 for anti-SLAPP proceedings and $21,700 for the fee application, yet does not resolve their ongoing property conflict.

articles.title: Meet Hazmatt: Oklahoma’s 20-foot reclining robot made from discarded dumpsters, built for just over $14,000
articles.description: Norman, Oklahoma has unveiled a captivating new public sculpture named Hazmatt, crafted from recycled dumpsters. This striking giant robot, funded by surplus construction funds totaling slightly over $14,000, is strategically located at the city’s Household Hazardous Waste Facility. Hazmatt serves to inspire the community, highlighting the importance of responsible waste management and showcasing the potential for creative reuse of discarded materials.

articles.description: Her Honor Mentoring began with a modest gathering of girls two decades ago and has since flourished remarkably. Participants acquire vital skills, including financial literacy, that prepare them for both college and professional futures while fostering nurturing relationships that empower young women to chase their dreams.

articles.title: Reddit Fights Teen Account Ban: Platforms contest Australia’s under-16 law; ruling may sway global curbs
articles.description: In late 2025, Australia enacted a law prohibiting individuals under 16 from accessing social media. However, Reddit and a libertarian organization are contesting this legislation in the High Court. While the law seeks to safeguard youth, it faces backlash for its lacking effectiveness, as many teenagers under this age still manage to go online. The government has responded by imposing stricter penalties on non-compliant social media platforms.

articles.title: Indian Coast Guard recruitment 2026: Offline applications close today for Foreman of Stores posts
articles.description: Indian Coast Guard recruitment 2026: The Indian Coast Guard will close offline applications for Foreman of Stores recruitment 2026 on November 3. The recruitment covers four Group B, Non-Gazetted, Non-Ministerial vacancies under the Ministry of Defence. Eligible candidates aged 18 to 30 years can apply with the prescribed qualifications and relevant experience. The selection process includes application scrutiny, document verification and a written examination. There is no application fee, and applications must be sent through Ordinary Post to the designated Noida address.

articles.title: Paris Jackson is demanding that her father’s estate pay alleged dues worth USD 600 million
articles.description: Paris Jackson has filed a court case demanding USD 600 million from her father's estate over inheritance delays. She accuses the executors of blocking her and her siblings from receiving their rightful shares. Despite the estate generating substantial income, she claims the family trust remains unfunded. The estate representatives deny withholding payments and say over USD 200 million has been distributed.

articles.title: Meghan Markle’s father admitted to Florida dementia care facility amid ongoing investigation
articles.description: Thomas Markle Sr., estranged father of Meghan Markle, has entered a care facility for dementia treatment. He moved back to America after living in the Philippines for several years. His relocation followed major health issues, including a stroke that resulted in the amputation of his left leg. Allegations regarding explicit material found in his residence are under investigation by local authorities.
